nodes.title: Gate 2 H5 built (dc-r8-gate2-habit-children; branch claude/r8-gate2-h5h7 from claude/r7-games 8f5412387; NAMING_OFF unchanged; nothing a child sees changes). For stambh/tally, kon/place and kon/name (shared/play.ts FACTS_UNTIL_NAMED, independent of NAMING_OFF), until a level names a mix-up (no row of hers carries misconceptionId), the seam row the teacher gets is exactly game, verdict, first_try, checks (checks: the family's checks, else its commits); an impasse row is game, checks (server/play/routes.js seamOut). Gone from it: the family's facts (bundles, answer, read, made, placed, said, picked, shown ...) and the lead's misses, extra, chose, next. The raw act stays in the trail. A named level keeps naming's own row unchanged. Every miss in these modes leaves the play server at GAME_WEIGHT 0.5 (server/play/levels.js nameOnRepeat): a pick's miss in the mix-up's form was CHANCE_WEIGHT 0.25 (kon/name say and find, kon/place's four picks, tally read), and an unconfirmed say sighting (H3) kept 0.25. 0.5 because a miss is not luck (shared/play.ts on CHANCE_WEIGHT), and it is what withNaming (naming off) and a named row already give; the grade inside the server keeps 0.25 and chanceMis for the session's memory. Reverse if: the teacher needs a fact of her act before naming that cannot be told from right, wrong, first try and checks (then add it as a named field and prove it carries no mix-up), or main extends the equal-weight rule to every family's picks.

Gate 2 H7 built: stambh/tally keep is asserted over all 582 levels the generator can make (enumerated from KEEP_SCENE, keepRowsAt, rows 2-14, tellsApart; was 269 from 12 seeds); kon/place's gate-2 tables over all 2,510 (kon.place.ts placeLevelOf, the function generatePlace now calls, swept over every key, orientation, tilt and fade, first accepted point on a grid of the continuous draws; served levels byte-identical; was 1,014 param sets from 8 seeds, keys 60, 65, 70, 160 now in). kon/name's space (tens of millions of figures) cannot be enumerated: the gate keeps its sample (621 say, 1,280 find) and KON_NAME_GATE2_FULL=1 runs 36,475 say and 63,948 find levels (90 s); the battery's discriminating say levels come from 200 seeds under HABIT_FULL=1. Reverse if: a level generated by generatePlace lies outside placeLevelOf's grid (the test cross-checks every sampled level), or a tally keep level is generated outside the enumeration.

H5 and H7 measured (tests/r8-gate2-facts-row.test.mjs, r8-games-stambh-tally, r8-games-kon-place-gate2, r8-games-kon-name-gate2). H5 through POST /api/play/act (naming off, as served): gate 77 served levels, 467 level ends; H5_FULL=1 313 levels, 2,483 ends, 230 s; every seam row exactly game, verdict, first_try, checks, every miss 0.5, the signed trail the raw replay; naming on (the battery's path) gate 408 levels, 102 named with naming's own row. H7: keep 582 levels, fewest slips 3 (336), 4 (222), 5 (24), worst one slip in every row 1/16; kon/place 2,510 levels, every assertion holds, worst figures unchanged (vertex-off drop 0.0929 -> 0.0930); cross-check: 742,987 generated levels over 3,000 seeds, none outside the enumeration. kon/name wide sweep: find has levels where one slip off the key lands on the mix-up's arc 0.221 (the packet said 1 in 5 at worst): the third sighting is 0.036 a session (was 0.027), still under 1 in 10. Times: tally file 10 s, kon/place gate-2 6 -> 16 s, kon/name gate-2 3 s (90 s full), facts-row test ~42 s.
